description: Header file defining the GeneralLossAlgorithm class for TCP loss detection in QUIC, implementing loss detection based on NACKs and time thresholds.

classes.name: GeneralLossAlgorithm
classes.description: Implements TCP-style loss detection for QUIC, configurable for loss based on NACK count or time thresholds.

methods.name: DetectLosses
methods.description: Determines which packets are lost based on current unacked packets, time, and RTT stats.

methods.name: GetLossTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout value for loss detection timer.

methods.name: SpuriousLossDetected
methods.description: Handles spurious loss detection events to adjust thresholds.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the loss detection with packet number space and parent interface.

methods.name: set_reordering_threshold
methods.description: Sets the reordering threshold for loss detection.

methods.name: set_use_adaptive_reordering_threshold
methods.description: Enables or disables adaptive reordering threshold.

methods.name: enable_adaptive_time_threshold
methods.description: Enables adaptive time threshold for loss detection.

methods.name: disable_packet_threshold_for_runt_packets
methods.description: Disables packet threshold for runt packets.
